This might be one of the best worst resumes I've ever seen.

Not because the person isn't capable.

Because this resume accidentally demonstrates almost every mistake that keeps people from getting interviews.

Too much information.

The wrong information.

Typos.

A second page.

Social media that doesn't add value.

And almost nothing that answers the one question every employer is asking:

"How are you going to help us?"
